description: This file defines a Swing-based user interface component for configuring the HonoSenderSampler in a JMeter testing environment. It provides UI elements such as text fields, checkboxes, and choice controls, allowing users to set parameters for sending telemetry and event messages through Hono endpoints. It also includes methods to create, modify, configure, and clear the UI, and to produce corresponding test elements for execution.

classes.name: HonoSenderSamplerUI
classes.description: A Swing UI class for configuring HonoSenderSampler parameters in JMeter, providing user input fields and methods to create, modify, configure, and reset test element settings.

methods.name: HonoSenderSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor initializing UI components for user configuration.

methods.name: getStaticLabel
methods.description: Returns the static label name for the UI panel.

methods.name: createTestElement
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HonoSenderSampler and applies current UI settings.

methods.name: modifyTestElement
methods.description: Updates the given TestElement (HonoSenderSampler) with current UI selections.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Populates the UI elements with values from an existing HonoSenderSampler.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Resets all UI fields and options to their default state.
